codeberg-django-allauth.why: Forgejo-native. Ships .gitea/pull_request_template.md and .gitea/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ beside a .github/ kept for the GitHub mirror, and runs Woodpecker rather than Actions. Deleting .github/ from this tree is the reduction #291 was demonstrated on.

gitlab-runner.why: GitLab-native, with no .github/ at all. Carries .gitlab/CODEOWNERS, .gitlab/issue_templates/ and .gitlab/merge_request_templates/ — GitLab's spellings differ from every other forge's, so this is the layout that proves the path table is a table and not a prefix substitution. It ships no security policy, which makes it the captured proof that a real absence still reads as a measured absence.
